Population increased in Epping Forest

The estimated population of Epping Forest in 2024 was 137,451 usual residents, a rise of 0.9% since 2023.

This meant that Epping Forest's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Epping Forest increased by 1.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Epping Forest was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Epping Forest

The average (median) age stayed at 42.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Epping Forest has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Epping Forest is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Epping Forest's population of 137,451 usual residents was made up of:

  • 25,482 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.5%)
  • 84,319 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.3%)
  • 27,650 people aged 65 years and over, (20.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Epping Forest has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (61.3% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Epping Forest, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Epping Forest
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Epping Forest, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 125 people (0.1%). In total, there were 1,380 births and 1,255 deaths in Epping Forest.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 537 (0.4%). There were 9,324 people entering the area and 8,787 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Epping Forest's population of 614 (0.5%) as a result of 1,198 people entering the area and 584 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Epping Forest was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Epping Forest in mid-2023 is 136,176.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 448 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 247 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 201 people.
